subject: Commerce
examFormat: Two papers forming a composite paper taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has fifty multiple-choice questions answered in 50 minutes for 50 marks. Paper 2 has eight essay-type questions, any five to be answered in 2 hours for 100 marks.

topics.name: Introduction to Commerce
objectives: Define commerce and e-commerce
Describe the history/background of commerce
State the scope of commerce and e-commerce
State the functions of commerce and e-commerce

topics.name: Occupation
objectives: Explain the meaning of occupation
Identify the types of occupation: industrial, commercial and service
Identify factors that determine types of occupation/employment
Identify career opportunities

topics.name: Production
objectives: Explain the meaning of production
Identify the factors of production: land, labour, capital and entrepreneurship
Identify the types of production: primary, secondary and tertiary
Explain division of labour/specialization: meaning, types, advantages, disadvantages and limitation
Explain the inter-relationship between production and exchange

topics.name: Business Units
objectives: Explain the meaning and objectives of business
Identify the forms of business units: sole proprietorship, partnership, co-operative societies, credit union and thrift societies, public enterprises and companies
State the types, formation, characteristics, comparison, advantages and disadvantages of each
Identify the sources of capital of each form of business
Explain the meaning and purpose of amalgamations, mergers and acquisitions, trust, holding companies and subsidiaries, consortium and cartel
Explain the dissolution/liquidation of companies and partnerships

topics.name: Trade Associations
objectives: State the aims and functions of trade associations
State the aims and functions of the Chamber of Commerce and employers' associations
State the aims and functions of consumer associations/consumerism

topics.name: Business Capital and Profits
objectives: Explain the meaning and types of capital: authorized/registered/nominal, called-up, paid-up, capital owned and liquid/circulating capital
Explain credit: meaning, sources, instruments and functions
Calculate working capital and state its importance
Explain profits: meaning, types and calculation
Explain turnover: meaning, calculation and factors affecting it

topics.name: Trade
topics.content: Home trade and foreign trade: meaning and differences, and the purpose and branches of trade.

subtopics.name: Home Trade
objectives: Explain retail trade, the functions of the retailer, factors to consider in starting a retail business and reasons for success/failure of a retail business

Distinguish small scale from large scale retailing and describe the types of retail outlet: unit shops, stalls, hawkers, kiosks, mobile shops, supermarkets, chain stores, department stores, shopping malls, hypermarkets and mail order business
State the main characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of each retail outlet
Describe modern trends in retailing: branding, self service, vouchers, vending machines and credit cards
Explain wholesale trade, the functions and types of wholesalers, and merchant and agent wholesalers
Explain the factors making for the elimination and survival of middlemen
Explain channels of distribution: meaning, types and factors for choice of channel

subtopics.name: Foreign Trade
objectives: Explain the meaning and types of foreign trade: import, export and entrepot

Explain basic concepts in international trade: terms of trade, balance of trade, balance of payments (favourable and unfavourable), visible and invisible items, bilateral and multilateral agreements and counter trade
State the advantages and disadvantages of foreign trade
Identify barriers to foreign trade
Explain tariffs: meaning and reasons for tariffs
Explain the functions of port and airports authorities, customs and excise authority, shipping, clearing and forwarding agents, and the export promotion council

topics.name: Purchase and Sale of Goods in Home and Foreign Trade
objectives: Describe the procedure and documents used in business: order, indent, consular invoice, ordinary invoice, credit/debit notes, proforma invoice, letter of hypothecation, documentary credit, certificate of origin, certificate of inspection and insurance certificate
Explain price quotation: trade discount, cash discount, quantity discount, COD, CWO, CIF, FOB, E & OE, ex-works, loco, FAS, FOR and franco
Explain terms of payment: cash/spot payment, purchase and deferred payment

Describe means of payment: legal tender (bank notes and coins), cheques, standing order, bank draft, stamps, postal orders, money orders, bills of exchange and promissory note, mail transfer, traveller's cheques, telegraphic transfer and e-payment

subtopics.name: Money
objectives: Explain the meaning, evolution/history and forms of money
State the qualities and functions of money

subtopics.name: Banks
objectives: Describe the types of bank: Central Bank, commercial banks and other specialized banks (development bank, mortgage bank, building society, micro finance institutions), their features and functions
Explain the meaning and functions of bureau-de-change
Explain e-banking: meaning and forms (ATM, money transfer) and e-payment (online transfer)
Describe the main features of current, savings and fixed deposit accounts

subtopics.name: Insurance
objectives: Explain the meaning and basic principles of insurance: utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity and subrogation, contribution and proximate cause
Describe the types of insurance: life (whole life assurance, endowment) and non-life (motor vehicle, fire, fidelity, burglary/robbery/theft, accidents, consequential loss, marine)
Distinguish insurable risks (fundamental risks, pure risk, particular risk) from uninsurable risk (speculative risk)
Explain the importance of insurance to business and the individual
Describe the procedure for taking an insurance policy
Explain underwriting
Explain re-insurance: meaning and purpose

subtopics.name: Capital Market
objectives: Explain the meaning and functions of the capital market
Describe methods of raising funds by companies: offer for sale, offer for subscription, rights issue, private placement and issue by tender
Explain the second tier securities market: meaning, functions, advantages to companies/public and requirements for listing

subtopics.name: Stock Exchange (first tier)
objectives: Explain the meaning, functions and importance of the stock exchange
Describe transactions on the stock exchange
Explain speculators: meaning and types
Identify types of security: shares, stock, bonds, gilt-edged securities, debentures and convertible loans

subtopics.name: Commodity Exchange
objectives: Explain the meaning of commodity exchange and the types of tradable commodities
State the requirements for trading: grading, standardizing, warehousing and clearing system
Describe methods of trading: open outcry and electronic mechanisms
State the benefits of commodity exchange

subtopics.name: Transport
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of transport and the choice of transport
Describe the forms of transport: land, water, air and pipeline
State the advantages and disadvantages of each form
Describe transport documents: waybills, consignment note, tickets and manifest

subtopics.name: Tourism
objectives: Explain the meaning of tourism
State the advantages and disadvantages of tourism

subtopics.name: Communication
objectives: Explain the meaning of communication
Describe the types: oral, written, visual, non-verbal, non-visual and traditional
State the advantages and disadvantages of communication
Explain the importance and services of the Post Office
Describe courier agencies and other communication agencies: telephone system, satellite services and internet/e-mail
Explain computer appreciation: meaning, component parts, advantages and disadvantages

subtopics.name: Warehousing
objectives: Explain the meaning, importance, functions and types of warehousing
State the advantages of warehousing

topics.name: Advertising
objectives: Explain the meaning of advertising
State the roles, advantages and disadvantages of advertising
Identify the types of advertising: informative, persuasive, competitive and mass/specific
Describe the methods of advertising: direct and indirect
Explain advertising media: meaning, choice and types

subtopics.name: Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning, importance and functions of marketing
Distinguish market from marketing, and market research from marketing research

subtopics.name: Marketing Concept and the Marketing Mix (4Ps)
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of the marketing concept
Explain the marketing mix and its components: product, price, place and promotion

subtopics.name: Customer Services
objectives: Explain the meaning and importance of customer services
Identify the types: pre-sales and after-sales services

subtopics.name: Sales Promotion
objectives: Explain the meaning and methods of sales promotion: trade fairs, exhibitions, gifts and demonstration
Explain personal selling: meaning and importance

topics.name: Legal Aspects of Business
topics.content: Areas of law that relate to business.

subtopics.name: Contract
objectives: Explain the meaning of a contract
State the elements of a valid contract
Explain the discharge of a contract

subtopics.name: Agency
objectives: Explain the meaning and creation of agency
State the duties and responsibilities of principals and agents
Explain the termination of agency

subtopics.name: Sale of Goods Act, Hire Purchase Act and Employment Rights
objectives: Explain the Sale of Goods Act
Explain the Hire Purchase Act
State the rights and obligations of employer and employee

subtopics.name: Government Regulation and Registration of Business
objectives: Explain government regulation of business: patents, copyright and trade mark
Explain the registration of business

subtopics.name: Consumer Protection
objectives: Explain the meaning of consumer protection and the need for it
Identify the means and instruments of protection
Explain consumerism
Explain government legislation: Food and Drugs Act, Standards Organization Act, Price Control Act, Factory, Shops and Offices Act and product quality

topics.name: Government Policies Relating to Business
objectives: Explain commercialisation, privatisation and deregulation: meaning and reasons
State the advantages and disadvantages of each
Compare and state the differences between them

topics.name: Introduction to Business Management
objectives: Explain the meaning and objectives of business
Explain the meaning and functions of business management
Identify business resources: man, money, materials, opportunities/goodwill
Describe the structure of the business organizational set-up: organisational chart, departments and their functions, authority, delegation of authority, responsibility and span of control
Explain business and its environment: economic, political, competition, technological, etc.
Explain the social responsibility of business to society
Explain the importance of inter- and intra-departmental communications

topics.name: Economic Groupings
objectives: Describe the history, membership, objectives, achievements and problems/obstacles of ECOWAS, the Niger Basin Commission (NBC), the Lake Chad Basin Commission (LCBC), the Mano River Union, the European Union and the West African Clearing House
